name: pm-guidelines
description: Cross-project PM best practices enforcement — 691 guidelines, 17 skills, 2 slash commands, 7 agents, 9 hooks (7 quality checks in single dispatcher + 2 PreToolUse guards). v1.10.0 hardens the sprint-insights skill on report verifiability: rule 12 now requires BOTH operands of in-sprint % and eventual % to be published as their own table columns (Planned @close / Completed @close / In-sprint % then Items now / Completed now / Eventual %) under a two-tier header separating at-close (immutable, ASOF) from today (live membership, no ASOF) — labelling the denominator in a callout proved insufficient, because a reader can only test a percentage against numbers on its own row; and new rule 14 requires every data-table column to carry a bilingual ? tooltip with its exact definition and the query behind it. Origin: the KhairGate BMS & Wallet Jul-19 board report printed Eventual % with neither numerator nor denominator anywhere in the document, so 92% (really 144/156) read as broken against the printed Planned 177 / Completed 114, and Sprint 6-BMS showed 22% < 27% — impossible on a shared denominator. Global lessons #1291 (amended), #1332, #1333. v1.9.0 adds the sprint-insights skill — the Sprint Governance & Reporting workflow for an Azure DevOps project (derive + CONFIRM the project-named deliverables folder, set it up or reconcile a mis-named one, then produce the bilingual EN/AR sprint-governance deliverable set — sprint report, governance validation, gap-closure, executive brief, success-criteria scorecard, operational action plan — from a LIVE read-only ADO pull; pairs with the /sprint-insights slash command and the feedback-sprint-insights-request-workflow memory rule). v1.8.0 adds Tier 1 operationalization of lessons #746-#776: frozen-artifact guard (extends source_file_protection with .pm-frozen-paths config — blocks edits to FROZEN HTML files like PMO Dashboard v10/v11/v12/v13/v14 + STP v3-v8); electron_renderer_check PreToolUse hook (blocks window.prompt/alert/confirm + renderer-side localhost fetch in Electron renderer files; warns on new ipcMain.handle); pm-multi-version-clone skill (3-rule v[N-1]→v[N] HTML clone hygiene); pm-cross-dashboard-drift agent (audits stale jump-list hrefs + localhost port drift + new Date(+'Z') NaN traps); pm-coverage-matrix skill (3-rule discipline: matrix-before-create, AskUserQuestion-options, delete-with-migration). v1.8.0 also adds the lesson-refinement workflow toolchain — the /pm-guidelines:PM-lessons-audit slash command (deterministic structural audit of global_lessons.md), the pm-lessons-content-duplicates agent (semantic dupe detector), and the /pm-guidelines:PM-lessons-refine orchestrator (chains audit + decision sheet + renumber + merge + verify + PR), plus the lesson-gap-analyzer deterministic-primitives fix (PR #1) and Rule 38-bis (reflog-aware mid-session verification) in pm-session-discipline. Earlier versions: v1.7.0 added pm-data-readiness skill + pm-link-auditor agent.
